video.title: Numbers to 1000 Song | Grade 2 Maths for Kids | Little Takhti
video.description:
Sing along and learn numbers to 1000! Ten ones make a ten, ten tens make a hundred, and every digit has its place: hundreds, tens and ones.
Find out what the zero in 708 means, compare 452 and 425, count by hundreds to 1000, then shout out the answers in the quiz. For ages 7 to 8.

Free Numbers to 1000 worksheets, quiz and games for grown-ups to print: littletakhti.com (tap the website link on the Little Takhti channel page)
